@copilot Update this PR directly to finish the originally requested K-Z Gradle guideline rollout from #21198. Keep its existing cloud-managed head branch and do not create or rename a branch, create another PR, or change any other rollout batch.

The first attempt delivered useful execution/source scoping in 10 files, but all 25 assigned scripts still contain the old `testing { suites { ... } }` wrapper. The remaining 15 assigned scripts were not changed at all. The requested single `testing.suites { ... }` container is an explicit requirement, even though the old nesting is behaviorally equivalent. Preserve the existing changes while completing this missing migration in every assigned script.

Read `.github/instructions/instrumentation-gradle.instructions.md` and `.github/instructions/testing-modes.instructions.md`. Use one top-level `testing.suites` container per assigned build, all source/dependency/compilation registrations first, then collection-level execution declarations. Keep exactly one executions block per suite including shared selectors, retain default-only settings in configureDefault and genuinely shared settings in configureEach, and keep global Test configuration shared.

Preserve task names, dependency pins and compatibility graphs, helper-suite agent-free behavior, check membership and realization, JDK/denyUnsafe gates, declarative configuration paths, JVM settings and providers, discovery filters, resource mappings, and telemetry metadata profiles.
